summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of Restaurant POS app (offline-style). 27 backend pytest tests passed (100%) covering auth (login, register, logout, role checks), categories CRUD, menu items CRUD, inventory (read/update/low-stock), orders (cash & credit with stock deduction verified), X/Z reports (admin-only Z), and dashboard stats. Frontend Playwright flow: admin login -> dashboard with 8 stat cards -> create category -> create menu item under category -> POS add to cart -> cash payment -> credit payment -> inventory shows correct deducted stock (20-2-1=17) -> stock update to 50 -> X report -> Z report -> Z report close -> logout -> register new cashier -> verify cashier sees only POS & Reports nav (no Dashboard, Menu, Inventory) and no Z/History tabs. All flows working.
critical_code_review_comments: secure=False on auth cookies in server.py (lines 133-134, 149-150). Acceptable for local/preview but should be True (or env-driven) when deployed over HTTPS to prevent cookie leakage.
CORS middleware uses FRONTEND_URL only; CORS_ORIGINS env var declared in backend/.env is unused (dead config).
GET /api/reports/x has no role guard while GET /api/reports/z does. This matches the cashier ability to view X reports per requirements but is worth confirming with product.
DELETE /api/categories/{id} cascade-deletes menu_items - good, but no transaction; if menu deletion fails, category is already gone. Acceptable for offline POS scope.
Order endpoint does not validate stock availability before deduction (uses max(0, ...)) - could allow overselling silently. Consider rejecting orders when stock < quantity.
No password length / strength validation on /auth/register; any password (incl. empty) is accepted by Pydantic.
/api/inventory and /api/orders/today exclude `_id` correctly. /api/auth/me converts ObjectId to str. Looks good overall on serialization.
test_credentials: admin@restaurant.com / admin123 (admin). Test cashier registered dynamically per run.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed category and menu item via pytest; cleaned up at end. Frontend test created TestCat_<ts> and Wings_<ts> items - left in DB for manual inspection if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_restaurant_pos.py covers all 7 resource groups. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Frontend uses data-testid extensively (sidebar nav-*, login-*, pos-item-*, cart-*, generate-x-report-btn, etc.). Admin sees Dashboard/POS/Menu/Inventory/Reports; cashier sees only POS/Reports and X-report tab (no Z, no History). Auth uses httpOnly cookies but Authorization Bearer is also accepted - tests use Bearer for simplicity.
rca of the issue: No bugs found - all features implemented correctly per problem statement.
